label: PF Backlog 301
title: Evidence-gated learning pipeline: auto-propose candidate learnings from outcomes; approve via API/HIL then apply (learning_synth + candidates store + API)
body:
Evidence-gated, approval-based (never auto-inject). At run teardown, collect evidence (closed RCCAs via core/issues, review-ledger feedback, defect_loop reconciles, media-QA findings via core/media_qa, quality/QIR deltas) -> cluster+score (reuse learnings._sim) -> write candidates to data/learning-candidates.json (new owner core/learning_synth.py; single writer). Candidates carry {id,kind:learning|overlay|skill|knowledge,text,rationale,evidence[],confidence,scope:project:

|area:|global,status:proposed}. Approval (HIL/API) promotes into the OWNER store via its API (learnings.add / prompt_overlays.set_overlay / knowledge_registry.add / SkillsRegistry.add_skill) - never writes them directly. Static instructions untouched. API-first: GET/POST /api/v1/learning/candidates[...]/approve|reject|edit + /learning/effectiveness (owner modules write, API reads). Reversible + audited. Default scope = project/area; global only on deliberate promotion (recurrence evidence).
_note: closed via issue IS-PF-0016: core/learning_synth.py; core/pipeline_executor.py (teardown); dashboard/api/app.py; config/store-registry.json; test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_learning_synth.py
